integration_notes: Retains the v2.3 material rates, geometry, stock selection and rafter-length labour curve.
Uses one $500 ex-GST operational startup per site plus $500 per pro-rated productive crew-day for both Simple and Bespoke.
Bespoke productive installation actions take 20% longer and add $1200 ex-GST design per site, $800 per additional pergola and $300 per additional module within a pergola.
Simple eligibility now includes standard acrylic gable and box-perimeter structures while retaining all other eligibility and structural-validity checks.
Simple and Bespoke use the same 1.3x customer-price multiplier and no classification uplift.
Published configurations retain the commercial behavior of their base manifest until a v2.4 configuration is explicitly published.
